**The line as it appears in `skills/steve/references/quotes.md`**

> 

**What is wrong with it**

Misattributed / wrong year or venue / never said / wording differs from the transcript. Pick one and say which.

**The evidence**

A link to a transcript, recording, published interview or document. The skill's one promise is that every quote can be traced; an issue that carries the trace gets fixed the same day.
